title: epan: OIDs: Deregister MIBs protocol and fields at shutdown
description:
The API can support deregistering the MIBs protocol and preventing
reported leaks at shutdown. (There are also leaks internal to libsmi.)
This goes a ways towards being able to extend it to deregistering
when the preferences change, and thus allowing the OID lookup
preferences to be changed without requiring a restart. There may
be some interactions (similar to other dynamically registered
fields) with MATE (and other post-dissectors) because
set_postdissector_wanted_hfids uses hfids (which change upon
de/re-registration).

Also change a few ID initial values from -1 to 0.

AI-Assisted: no
